release_notes.en-US: Version 2.0.0 adds a toolbar popup dashboard, Grandma preset, navigation blocking for family blocklists, bundled scam-host patterns, smishing detection, Fastmail and Tutanota support, email scam tips, tel/sms/javascript link guards, and auto after-scam protection on Continue. Still no telemetry or remote code.

version.approval_notes: 2.0.0: Toolbar popup, Grandma preset, webNavigation blocklist guard, bundled bad hosts, smishing, Fastmail/Tutanota, email tips, tel/sms/javascript guards. Submitted ZIP is readable unminified source; Build-Release.ps1 -Browser Firefox copies extension/, selects manifest.firefox.json, validates, and zips. No test credentials. Use any supported webmail session for inbox features. Support: https://nokaangel.dev/support?project=grandmaguard
